metaDescription: Seven ice makers listed at or below $500, from undercounter commercial style units to a compact nugget maker, compared on output, bin size and installation.
expertTake: The VEVOR 200 lb is the top pick for output and bin size at this cap. The VEVOR 90 lb is the value pick for a small commercial unit. Skip these if you have no water line or drain, and buy a countertop nugget maker instead.
introParagraphs: At the top of this cap you leave the countertop behind and enter undercounter machines that make and store far more ice. The tradeoff is installation: water supply, a drain plan and clearance.

This guide compares those machines with one compact nugget maker for readers who want a simple countertop alternative. Output ratings are best case, so bin size and installation notes matter as much as the headline number. Prices move, so the $500 cap reflects listing prices when this guide was updated.

products.name: VEVOR commercial ice maker 200 lb per day with 25 to 50 lb storage
products.description:
The VEVOR 200 lb is an ETL certified commercial style ice maker with 25 to 50 pounds of storage. It adds adjustable ice thickness and cyclopentane foam insulation. It is a bar and restaurant style unit.

It makes many times what a countertop unit does and needs plumbing and a drain plan. It is for people who entertain a lot. Its 200 lb rating and 25 to 50 lb bin beat the VEVOR 150 lb on volume.

Descale it on schedule and keep the vents clear. Check the drain method before installing. Before relying on the VEVOR 200 lb maker for a party, run it for an hour and note how much ice it really makes in your room, since rated output assumes cool air and cold water.
products.bestFor: Entertainers who want a large bin

products.name: VEVOR commercial ice maker 150 lb per day, built in or freestanding

specList.label: Install

products.description:
The VEVOR 150 lb produces up to 150 pounds a day with 16 to 30 pounds of storage. It can sit built in, freestanding or under a counter, and it has a dual water inlet. It suits a home bar.

The dual inlet lets you use a faucet or bottled water. It is a step below the 200 lb model. Its 150 lb rating comes with built in, freestanding or undercounter use.

Descale it on schedule and keep clearance. Check the drain method before installing. Plan where the VEVOR 150 lb maker will sit, with clear space around it and a flat, level surface, because blocked vents are the usual cause of weak output.
products.bestFor: Home bar owners who want flexible installation

products.name: EUHOMY commercial ice maker 120 lb per day, under counter, 33 lb bin
products.description:
The EUHOMY 120 lb is an undercounter ice maker with a 33 pound bin and a stainless steel body. It makes crystal clear cubes and uses a pure copper compressor. It can be freestanding or built in.

It sits between the 100 lb and 150 lb units. The copper compressor is a durability claim. Its 120 lb rating and 33 lb bin sit between the VEVOR units.

Descale it on schedule and keep clearance. Check the drain method before installing. Use filtered or distilled water in the EUHOMY 120 lb maker if your tap water is hard, as scale on the evaporator cuts output and makes ice taste flat.
products.bestFor: Households that want clear cubes and a steel body

products.name: EUHOMY commercial ice maker 100 lb per day, 45 cubes per cycle
products.description:
The EUHOMY 100 lb is an undercounter ice maker making 45 cubes per cycle with a 33 pound bin. It is ETL certified for commercial and home use. The body is stainless steel.

It is a modest commercial unit, smaller than the 120 lb sibling. It suits a home bar. Its 100 lb rating and ETL listing suit home bars.

Descale it on schedule and keep clearance. Check the drain method before installing. Keep the manual for the EUHOMY 100 lb maker nearby, since the descaling method and the standing time after a move are the two details owners most often miss.
products.bestFor: Home bar owners who want an ETL listed unit

products.name: Mojgar commercial ice maker 100 lb per day with 18 to 33 lb storage
products.description:
The Mojgar 100 lb is an undercounter ice maker making up to 100 pounds a day with 18 to 33 pounds of storage. It is described as easy to set up and plug and play. It includes a self cleaning function.

It is aimed at home bars. The wide storage range shows the bin size varies by listing. Its plug and play install beats the 120 lb EUHOMY on simplicity.

Descale it on schedule and keep clearance. Check the drain method before installing. Empty and dry the Mojgar 100 lb maker before storage or a long trip, because standing water grows slime in the reservoir within days.
products.bestFor: Home bar owners who want a simple setup

products.name: VEVOR commercial ice maker 90 lb per day with dual water inlet
products.description:
The VEVOR 90 lb produces up to 90 pounds a day and stores 6.8 to 13 pounds. It has a dual water inlet for a faucet or bottled water. It suits a bar.

It is the smallest of the VEVOR line. The small bin limits it to steady use. Its 90 lb rating and small bin make it the entry unit.

Descale it on schedule and keep clearance. Check the drain method before installing. Write down how often you refill the VEVOR 90 lb maker during a typical week, as that number tells you quickly whether its tank size suits your habits.
products.bestFor: Bar owners who want a small commercial unit

products.name: EUHOMY nugget ice maker countertop, 34 lb per day, ready in 7 min
products.description:
The EUHOMY 34 lb is a countertop nugget maker with a 7 minute first batch and a 34 pound rating. It makes soft chewable ice and has a self cleaning cycle. It is a plain, compact unit.

It is a lower output nugget option beside the commercial units here. It suits a household that wants chewable ice. At 34 lb it is a compact nugget maker, with no plumbing needs.

Descale it on schedule and empty the water before storage. Before relying on the EUHOMY 34 lb nugget for a party, run it for an hour and note how much ice it really makes in your room, since rated output assumes cool air and cold water.

buyingCriteria.criterion: Ice type: nugget, bullet or crescent
buyingCriteria.explanation: Nugget ice is soft, chewable and absorbs drink flavour, but nugget makers are heavier, louder and pricier because they scrape and compress ice. Bullet ice is hard and melts slower, and crescent ice is clear and slow melting. VEVOR 200 lb maker and EUHOMY 120 lb maker sit on different sides of that choice in this lineup. Choose by how you drink, not by the output number.

Countertop units refill by hand from a 1.1 to 1.8 L reservoir and need no plumbing, which suits renters and RVs. Undercounter commercial style units store a lot more ice and make far more, but need a drain, a water supply and clearance. VEVOR 150 lb maker and EUHOMY 100 lb maker show the difference in this lineup. Plumbing is the real cost of the larger category.

Portable ice makers do not keep ice frozen: melt water drains back to the reservoir and is recycled, so the ice is for immediate use. Insulated bins slow melting but do not stop it. VEVOR 150 lb maker (150 lb commercial) and EUHOMY 100 lb maker (100 lb commercial) handle storage differently. If you want ice ready all day, look at bin size and insulation.

Touchscreens, timers and app control are conveniences, while a self cleaning cycle flushes the reservoir but does not remove scale. Some nugget units add a dispenser so you can fill a cup without opening the lid. VEVOR 200 lb maker and EUHOMY 100 lb maker differ on controls. Choose the features you will use daily, not a long list.

buyingCriteria.criterion: First batch time and cycle length
buyingCriteria.explanation: The first batch usually takes 6 to 15 minutes, and later cycles repeat every 6 to 8 minutes, filling a basket in under an hour. A listing that quotes 6 or 7 minutes is describing the first cycle. VEVOR 200 lb maker and EUHOMY 120 lb maker quote different times in this lineup. Time to first ice matters for parties, while daily output matters for steady use.

Compressor units need breathing room, often 6 inches or more on all sides, and a blocked unit makes less ice and wears faster. Noise is compressor hum plus cubes dropping, roughly like a mini fridge for bullet makers and louder for nugget makers with an auger. VEVOR 150 lb maker and EUHOMY 100 lb maker are the picks to place with care. Do not put one in a cabinet with no airflow.

specDecoder.watchFor: Check the stated bin size for EUHOMY 100 lb maker.

specDecoder.meaning: The water tank of a countertop unit, often 1.1 to 1.8 L. A small tank means more refills during a party.
specDecoder.watchFor: See whether VEVOR 200 lb maker states its tank size.

specDecoder.meaning: A safety mark shows the unit was assessed to a recognised standard. It matters most for undercounter units installed in a home.
specDecoder.watchFor: Look for it on EUHOMY 100 lb maker.

specDecoder.meaning: Nugget is soft and chewable, bullet is hard and slow melting, and crescent is clear and curved. The shape affects taste and melt rate.
specDecoder.watchFor: Note which shape VEVOR 150 lb maker makes before buying.

howWeEvaluated.title: Ice type and use
howWeEvaluated.description: We matched nugget, bullet, crescent and cube styles to how people drink. We avoided ranking different ice types on output alone. EUHOMY 120 lb maker and EUHOMY 100 lb maker represent different types in this lineup.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We read the pattern of owner comments rather than any single score. Repeated complaints about noise, leaks or output lowered a pick. No review count or rating is quoted here, and none was used as a ranking number.

howWeEvaluated.title: Installation and clearance
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at drain needs, water supply and the clearance each unit demands. A unit that fits your space gets used. VEVOR 150 lb maker was the reference for a different installation style.

howWeEvaluated.title: Output and basket realism
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared stated daily output with basket size and cycle time, and treated output as a best case. VEVOR 200 lb maker at 200 lb commercial and VEVOR 150 lb maker at 150 lb commercial were compared this way.

howWeEvaluated.title: Cleaning and descaling
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked for self cleaning cycles and notes on descaling. We favoured designs with accessible reservoirs and trays. VEVOR 200 lb maker was set against the others on this point.

Countertop units refill by hand and need no plumbing, while commercial style units need water and drainage. The rows below map common situations to the picks in this lineup, including VEVOR 150 lb maker.

cards.label: Nugget ice
cards.text: The group of EUHOMY 34 lb nugget makes nugget ice. It is soft and chewable and absorbs drink flavour, but the machines are heavier, louder and pricier. It suits people who chew ice.

cards.label: Cube, bullet or crescent ice
cards.text: The group of VEVOR 200 lb maker, VEVOR 150 lb maker, EUHOMY 120 lb maker, EUHOMY 100 lb maker, Mojgar 100 lb maker, and VEVOR 90 lb maker makes harder, slower melting cubes. Hard cubes hold up in a drink and melt more slowly, and the machines are usually quieter. It suits people who want cold drinks that stay cold.

howToChoose.note: Pick nugget if you love chewing ice. Pick cubes if you want slower melting ice and a quieter, cheaper machine.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: Look for a high rated output, a basket or bin that holds enough for a party, a fast first batch and a way to refill without waiting. Storage matters more than the daily total, since a party draws a lot of ice in an hour. A scoop and an easy basket also help.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: VEVOR 200 lb maker is the pick that best matches those points here, with 200 lb commercial. VEVOR 150 lb maker and EUHOMY 120 lb maker are the nearest alternatives if you want a different ice type or a different mix of output and storage.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: Spend more if you entertain often, want nugget ice, or need a bin that holds hours of ice. Stepping up to VEVOR 200 lb maker (200 lb commercial) buys the output or storage that cheaper units lack.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: Save if you want a few drinks a day or ice for an occasional trip. EUHOMY 34 lb nugget (34 lb nugget) covers the basics, and a small difference in output rarely justifies a larger premium.

maintenance.task: Replace the water filter if fitted
maintenance.why: A saturated filter stops working and can leave off flavours. Follow the interval for your unit.
Dust blocks airflow to the compressor. A brush or a vacuum nozzle keeps the vents open.

maintenance.interval: After each use or before storage
maintenance.why: Standing water grows biofilm within days. Drain the tank and leave the lid open to dry.
Scale cuts output and flavour. Use citric acid or a manufacturer approved cleaner, then rinse well.

maintenance.task: Stand the unit upright after moving
maintenance.why: Compressor oil needs a few hours to settle. Let the machine stand upright before powering on.

faq.q: How often should I descale an ice maker?
faq.a: Every month or two is a good rule in hard water areas. Use citric acid or a manufacturer approved cleaner and rinse well. Skipping it is the most common cause of falling output.

faq.q: Do I need a drain for an ice maker?
faq.a: Countertop units do not, but undercounter commercial style units usually do. Check the installation notes before buying one. EUHOMY 100 lb maker is an example of a larger unit that needs planning.

faq.q: Is nugget ice worth the extra cost?
faq.a: If you love soft, chewable ice, yes, since nugget makers are the only way to get it at home. They are heavier, louder and pricier than bullet makers. A pick like VEVOR 150 lb maker shows how they differ.

faq.q: Can I move an ice maker after using it?
faq.a: Yes, but let it stand upright for a few hours before powering on so compressor oil settles. Empty the water first. This applies to every compressor based unit in this guide.

faq.q: Does a portable ice maker keep ice frozen?
faq.a: No, the basket is not a freezer, so ice slowly melts and the water returns to the reservoir. Plan to use or move ice quickly. Larger insulated bins slow this, such as the one on EUHOMY 120 lb maker.

faq.q: Why does this guide stop at $500?
faq.a: The $500 cap is the search keyword shoppers use, and every pick here was listed at or below it when this guide was updated. EUHOMY 34 lb nugget is the cheapest option in this lineup and VEVOR 200 lb maker is the dearest, so the spread inside the cap is real. Prices move, so check the listing before you buy.
